titulo: Avalanche’s AVAX leads crypto gains following NYSE tokenization deal
descricao: Avalanche’s AVAX token rose as much as 10% after the NYSE selected its blockchain to support settlement on a planned tokenized stock trading platform.

titulo: Ava Labs exec says NYSE deal marks end of blockchain’s ‘general purpose era’
descricao: Ava Labs’ John Nahas said the collaboration with the NYSE shows institutions moving past pilots toward purpose-built onchain market infrastructure.
